content: No mature, actively maintained npm package renders radar/spider charts in the terminal. terminal-charter claims radar chart support but has ~1 weekly download (essentially unused/unmaintained) -- avoid. chartscii (v4.0.3, 15.5k weekly downloads) only supports bar charts. cli-table3 (v0.6.5, 28.6M weekly downloads) is the standard, healthy choice for unicode tables. Recommendation: render per-dimension readiness as horizontal bar rows built manually with cli-table3 + block characters/picocolors, not a fragile radar-chart dependency.
